acceptance: Decision gate: the item stays blocked until a pytest-xdist release after 3.8.0 includes the fix for pytest-dev/pytest-xdist#1378 (#1324 and #1328, both merged on master). Check the PyPI version and the upstream changelog before starting.
That release is locked with uv lock --upgrade-package pytest-xdist, and both pytest-xdist floors in pyproject.toml (the dev extra, >=3.0.0, and the second entry, >=3.8.0) are raised to it.
A worker killed mid-session under --dist loadscope lets the session finish: shown with a test that kills its own worker, or by citing the upstream regression test.

--max-worker-restart=0 is removed from the medium-tier command in ci.yml, trunk.yml and trunk-coverage.yml. Pass: grep -n max-worker-restart across the three workflows returns nothing, or the reason it stays is recorded here.
Exit gate: if no release after 3.8.0 exists by 2027-03-31, the owner decides between keeping the flag permanently (close this item) and waiting longer. The decision is recorded here.

Guardrails: medium-tier verification runs only through the heavy-lock entry points; pytest-xdist is never installed from git or a fork; if the release does not contain both fixes, the flag stays and nothing changes.
context:
2026-11-17: latest pytest-xdist on PyPI is 3.8.0, already locked. Blocked on an upstream release.

Owner decision 2026-11-17: keep blocked until the exit date recorded in acceptance.
description: PR #4121 added --max-worker-restart=0 to the medium-tier pytest command in ci.yml, trunk.yml and trunk-coverage.yml because pytest-xdist 3.8.0 with --dist loadscope cannot finish a session after a worker dies (pytest-dev/pytest-xdist#1378; fixed on master by #1324 and #1328, unreleased on 2026-11-11). The flag turns a 25-minute hang into a fast failure that names the test, but it also means one crashed worker ends the shard.
